reason: The direction mostly holds, but the proposed chat line misstates the evidence. (1) '9 of 12 bronze' is labelled 'стандартный prior CI', but 7 of the 12 runs in mc37_p2p3.txt use CI_MU 0.0007, not the standing 0.0005. All four sensitivity runs (K_MU, RHO 0.5, overfit, qpub0) were done only at 0.0007, which the finding itself calls an update for reads 2 and 3, and read 3 is exp75. At the standing mean, mc37 has P2 ahead on bronze in only 2 of 3 runs (sd 0.0015: P3 .779 vs .773, and P3 is also ahead on Eval). (2) 'посчитана до чтения exp75' is false. The runs were made at 09:13-09:35Z, after the 09:09Z read. mc26.py is unchanged and does not take exp75's display as an input, but choosing the 0.0007 grid used that read. (3) The break-even is understated. I re-ran 27 runs with mc26.py unchanged, VPUB=exp87a and the standing CI_MU 0.0005 (scratchpad r37skep/mc_std_grid.txt). At sd 0.0008, P2 is ahead on bronze in 9 of 9 runs (+0.02 to +0.05). At sd 0.0012 it is ahead in 8 of 9 (+0.002 to +0.03; P3 wins overfit, .850 vs .839). At sd 0.0015 it is a tie: P3 is ahead in 5 of 9 (overfit, qpub0, seeds 11/23/41) and P2 in 4 of 9, by at most .018. The bronze break-even CI mean is below +0.0002 at sd 0.0008, ~+0.0004 at sd 0.0012 (not +0.0003) and ~+0.0006 at sd 0.0015. That is about half of the public step, not a third. (4) 'Silver 12 of 12' is a structural artefact, not evidence about CI. In mc26 CI is one shared draw, so P2 - P3 = CI + max(C+K,0) - max(C+K+CI,0), and P2 >= P3 in a world exactly when CI > 0. P2 still leads on silver at a CI mean of -0.0003 (.480 vs .473), which shows the silver lead comes from upper-tail variance. (5) Card v5 already shows the user P2's model ranges above P3's (l.39 bronze ~0.75-0.93 vs l.41 ~0.68-0.85). Step 10 says 'Числа модели не пересчитывать'. R34's skeptic allowed only a standing-prior caption with the user's OK. So the line adds only the break-even, and its version of the break-even is the optimistic end. Private value: 0 directly, since no file, slot or rule changes. The model's gap between P2 and P3 is at most ~0.03 bronze probability and vanishes at sd 0.0015. Feasibility is trivial (a chat line), but as worded it would nudge the user with overstated numbers ~8 h before the tick.
fix: Keep card v5 unchanged (order, wording, step 10). If the session sends a caption, send it only in the chat message, marked as recomputed after the exp75 read. Use the standing-prior grid, not the 0.0007 runs: 'Для сведения (модель mc26 пересчитана после чтения exp75 (само чтение в модель не входит); стандартный prior CI +0.0005): по бронзе П2 {exp87a, exp75} выше П3 {exp87a, #37} при разбросе CI на привате sd 0.0008 (9 из 9, +0.02…+0.05) и sd 0.0012 (8 из 9, до +0.03); при sd 0.0015 ничья (П3 впереди в 5 из 9). П3 лучше, если CI на привате даёт меньше ~+0.0004…+0.0006 (около половины паблик-шага) или вредит. Серебро у П2 выше во всех прогонах, но это свойство модели, а не довод. Выбор за вами.' No rule change and no word 'рекомендую'. The same line applies if V_pub becomes exp89t (CI).
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private by itself (information only). In the judgmental model, the P2-vs-P3 choice is worth <= ~0.03 bronze probability at CI sd <= 0.0012 and ~0 at sd 0.0015. The corrected wording prevents an overconfident nudge.
